pro_course_detail.title: Bahasa Indonesia for Beginner
pro_course_detail.description:
IF YOU ARE BEGINNERS
This lesson is right for the learner who wants to explore our language from a really basic level, or to strengthen what you have already learned. The class consists of several lessons which include self introduction, family, daily routine, food, question words, expressing feelings, asking about time and direction, occupation, and so forth. We will learn some key words which are normally used in daily life to create your own sentences, questions, and answers.
Practice make perfect, so that why during the lesson we will practice talking about simple topic.

Homework is available at student's request!

pro_course_detail.title: Indonesian Conversation
pro_course_detail.description: This lesson is for both beginner or intermediate students. The best way to improve your Indonesian speaking skills is to use them as much as possible. If you want to practice speaking, this lesson is for you, and I'll be your conversation partner! I will help you to correct grammar and pronunciation mistakes, so that you can talk more naturally like a native speaker.

pro_course_detail.title: Bahasa Indonesia for Intermediate to Advanced
pro_course_detail.description:
IF YOU ARE INTERMEDIATE OR WANT TO CUSTOMIZE YOUR LESSON
This class is relevant for people who wants to strengthen their knowledge grammatically and broaden their understanding of Indonesian, and is also appropriate for those who want to learn more vocabulary in context. We can read articles, discuss some topic, make presentation and practice using the words you learn in context.

Homework is available at student's request!

pro_course_detail.title: Javanese for Beginner [ꦧꦱꦗꦮ]
pro_course_detail.description:
This lesson is for beginner who just started learning Javanese (Ngoko) and still have limited vocabulary.
In this level you can study Javanese (Ngoko) from scratch and don't worry, if at the moment you only know "matur suwon", "piye kabare?" or "kate nandi?". You will learn a lot of vocabulary and common expression with me. You will learn about family, animal, direction, food, travel, hobbies, jobs, asking question, answering question, simple grammar, simple sentences, So you will be able to speak Javanese (Ngoko) for simple conversation soon.

En clase, tomamos un tema y lo conduzco de manera socrático, lo que significa que yo hago preguntas sobre el tema. De esta manera, estás siendo entrevistado y esto te da una oportunidad de expresarte libremente. Intervengo para serte de ayuda en desarrollar tus pensamientos y habilidades linguisticas.

pro_course_detail.description: For this lesson, we will have a conversation in Spanish about one or two topics per lesson (e.g. hobbies, work, philosophy, psychology, medicine, religion).
